title: plastic taco holders
text: plastic taco holders. I purchased these because I thought my grandsons would be impressed - 10 and 7 yrs - but neither were so I actually gifted them to a find who has younger kiddos.  That being said, they worked well.  They are plastic, red and green, lightweight. They hold 2 tacos each.  They are a little sharp on the under side.  I put paper towel on the plate to keep them from sliding around.  I think 4 or 5 yrs (?) is the target age maybe.  But totally functional and cute.  Washed and dried in the top rack dishwasher without issue.
